summary.text: Marc McMain is the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 46, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Ray Smith.
An entrepreneur from Monroe, he won the June 16, 2026 Republican primary runoff over Doug McKillip.

paragraphs.text: Marc McMain lives in Monroe, Georgia, graduated from Rockdale County High School in 1988 and earned an associate degree in Spanish, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes founding a karate school and a local magazine.
McMain ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Georgia's 10th Congressional District, finishing with 4.7% of the vote.

In a Ballotpedia survey from that campaign, he described himself as an outsider with more than 30 years of small business experience and said he supports term limits, the Second Amendment, border security and opposition to abortion.
